Name: Omni by xpander
Tagline: Stop babysitting your AI agents
Description: Omni is the AI engineer that takes your agents from a laptop to the cloud. Today, your best AI workflows still live in Claude on your machine - stopping when the lid closes, running for no one but you. Describe what you want, or bring what you've built, and Omni wires the tools and skills, tests on mock data, and hands you a running cloud agent: scheduled, long-running, shareable with your team. It keeps agents healthy too - improves system prompts, compares models, debugs and fixes failed runs.

Name: Meridian
Tagline: Don't let your work go unnoticed. Get promoted!
Description: Meridian is an open-source AI work journal that runs entirely on your device. It writes your work up in plain English as the day goes, so by the end of the day you have a summary of everything you did. Meridian automatically drafts your updates for your project management tools like Jira, ready to post once you approve them. Do the work. Let the remembering take care of itself. No cloud, no account. MIT-licensed, free.

Name: Clears
Tagline: Move beyond AI coding to Agentic Software Delivery
Description: Clears is an agentic execution platform for autonomous software delivery, helping R&D organizations move beyond individual AI tools to agentic execution across the entire SDLC.

Name: Vendo
Tagline: Let your users build their own features inside your product
Topics: Open Source, SaaS, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: Vendo is an open-source customization layer in your product that lets every customer add the features and micro-apps they need, just by describing what they want. Until now software has been rigid, and every customer had to adapt to it. Vendo makes it dynamic, so your product shapes itself around each customer, built on your own API and inside the guardrails you set.

Name: Scholé Scenarios
Tagline: Learn by doing
Description: Most learning tells you what to know, but doesn’t let you practice what you’ll actually do. Scholé Scenarios changes that by bringing real-world scenarios into adaptive learning. You will practice real situations throughout your lessons: explain what you just learned to a teammate, save the sale, discuss knowledgeably with a client. Scholé is an agentic learning system to adapt the learning that comes next, so you can practice the moments that matter.

Name: Replay QA for Teams
Tagline: Autonomous QA for teams who ship faster than they can verify
Description: Replay QA tests your web app like a real user, uncovering broken flows, UI issues, and bugs before they reach customers. It gives you the context behind each issue, plus suggested fixes. What's new: With shared projects, teammate mentions, localhost testing, and QA checks on every pull request, your whole team can catch and fix problems before shipping.

Name: OpenTrade
Tagline: Open-source trading harness for Claude Code / Codex.
Topics: Open Source, Investing, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: OpenTrade is an open-source harness for Claude Code / Codex agents that provide the tools and guardrails to trade effectively via Robinhood's official MCP. Out of the box, agents can setup cron schedules, custom scripts to notify themselves, and persistent background sessions – all on your machine.

Name: Startup Program by Recall.ai
Tagline: Startup program for meeting recording infrastructure
Description: The Recall.ai Startup Program gives early-stage teams reliable meeting recording infrastructure at $0.25/hour for their first 10,000 hours, plus engineer support, fast bot joins, every recording product, MCP access, and calendar integration.

Name: Treg
Tagline: OpenRouter for tools with 2,600 APIs, 0% markup
Topics: API, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Agents don't care about vendors - they want the best API for the task. treg gives your agent 2,600+ tools (SEO, social, leads, ads, scraping) behind one URL and one token. Search by task, see price/request/response, pay per call at 0% markup. Open source.

Name: Skriptr
Tagline: AI workspace for students
Description: Skriptr is the AI workspace for students, helping with research, writing, and learning. Skriptr reads your sources, shows the exact page behind every answer, and asks questions back. It work with you, not for you. The thinking stays yours.

Name: Hansel by Seedling
Tagline: Your email, your server, your keys so you're not locked out
Description: Hansel is a gmail/outlook replacement for teams that value privacy and ownership. Your email runs on YOUR server. Messages encrypt on YOUR device. The platform cannot read them. Spam is solved architecturally without your key, messages can't arrive. Includes encrypted messaging, email from your own domain, calendar, notes, and enterprise admin tools. No company can lock you out. Ever.

Name: Samepage Artifacts
Tagline: A context-aware, connected writing surface for product teams
Description: Artifacts by Samepage is your connected product management writing surface, where drafts are automatically generated and waiting for you: PRDs, release notes, feature briefs, weekly updates, and more.

Name: Bulbthings
Tagline: The AI platform to track and manage your physical assets
Description: Your business runs on a lot of stuff. Gear, equipment, tools, furniture, vehicles — yet most teams still track it all across spreadsheets and WhatsApp. Bulbthings is the AI-powered asset management platform that brings everything together: inventory, bookings, maintenance, and collaboration — beautifully, on desktop and mobile. No training needed, no chaos. Just one source of truth for every physical thing your business owns.

Name: TinyFish
Tagline: The web operating layer for AI agents
Description: TinyFish is a unified web operations platform built for AI agents and AI applications. It enables developers to search the live web, extract clean structured content, browse dynamic websites, and automate authenticated workflows through a single platform. By providing reliable access to current web data and web interactions, TinyFish helps AI systems deliver more accurate answers, reduce operational complexity, and scale production workloads.

Name: Blender Agent Bridge
Tagline: Open-source MCP bridge for Blender AI workflows
Topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, 3D Modeling
Description: Blender Agent Bridge is a free, open-source Blender extension that connects Blender to AI clients like Codex, Claude, and Cursor through MCP. It lets agents inspect scenes, gather visual evidence, and assist with workflows while keeping edits, script trust, paid generation, and approvals under the artist’s control. It Has integration with Meshy.ai, Tripo3D, Polyhaven and more.

Name: envfix
Tagline: A tiny .env doctor for Node.js projects
Description: envfix is a zero-dependency CLI for diagnosing and fixing environment configuration problems. It detects missing, empty, extra, and duplicate variables, catches malformed declarations, checks Git safety, generates and syncs example environment files, and works locally or in CI. Run it instantly with npx envfix.

Name: Astute
Tagline: New media for B2B brands, starting with creator partnerships
Description: Astute is the first B2B new media platform, starting with creator partnerships. We monitor your presence in the new media, build a data-backed strategy around the creators your buyers trust, and run the partnerships on autopilot. All within minutes.

Name: Culpa
Tagline: Find the exact conversation behind every AI dollar
Description: Culpa traces every AI dollar to the exact user, feature, conversation and retry loop that caused it, then forecasts what new features will cost before they run. Stop guessing at AI spend and start fixing it. Local-first so your prompts never leave your infrastructure. Find the culprit behind every spike, see which customers and workflows burn margin, and price new features and products with data instead of instinct.

Name: Talentz
Tagline: The signal layer for hiring.
Description: Zee is the agentic recruiting platform behind Talentz.ai. Three connected agents cover your full pre-hire loop. Zee Scout finds candidates by proof of work, searching where talent actually lives. Zee Engage runs two-way conversations across every channel on one thread. Zee Lens conducts structured AI video interviews and delivers decision-ready findings. Your hiring manager makes the call, backed by evidence instead of a resume.

Name: HookLens
Tagline: Real-time webhook triage & AI root-cause analysis
Description: Debug, monitor, and triage failed Stripe and Shopify webhooks instantly with Gemini AI. Turn cryptic JSON payloads into clear root causes and code-ready fixes.
